doc: MOR-3624 seam document: the duplex-offset command and its wire bytes, shared by the Python replay (tests/test_mor3624_repeater_offset_api.py) and the frontend twins (semantic-repeater-wiring.component.test.ts in this directory, mor2111-repeater-conformance.isolated.test.ts and repeater-adapter.test.ts under $lib/runtime/adapters/__tests__). The Python replay builds the same documents from the production builders (rigplane.commands set_freq_offset / get_freq_offset) and drives them through the production stack (real WebServer + IcomRadio over UDP + a MockIcomRadio with an offset register); regenerate by running that module — it asserts this file against the producer-built documents and fails on drift. Offsets are exact Hz; the wire carries 3-byte BCD in 100 Hz units, little-endian digit order (IC-705 CI-V Reference Guide A7560-8EX-1 p.3).
